notes: Hand-maintained corrections to the PokéAPI crawl, reviewed in pull requests (docs/release-architecture.md 13.3). `tags` lists species slugs per curated tag; every row of those species carries the tag. `keep` exempts a variety from the battle-only skip of rule 2 with the reason. `rows` patches a dataset row by slug: `games` and `tags` are added to the built values, any other column replaces it, and a slug PokéAPI does not know must give every column. `notes` inside a row is documentation.

keep.zacian-crowned: Crowned Sword is an item-held form listed as an included form in 13.1; PokéAPI flags it battle-only.
keep.zamazenta-crowned: Crowned Shield is an item-held form listed as an included form in 13.1; PokéAPI flags it battle-only.

zygarde-10-power-construct.notes: PokéAPI names both zygarde-10 and zygarde-10-power-construct "10% Forme".

zygarde-50-power-construct.notes: Distinguishes the Power Construct ability variant from the default 50% Zygarde.

minior-red.notes: The one Core row stands for every colour: the other six cores have the same stats, types and abilities and are dropped by rule 7.

persian-alola.notes: Regulation Set M-C addition (Serebii); PokéAPI has no Champions learnset for it yet.
